title: Many UAP sightings off the coast of San Diego
summary: Tyler Cowen tells of Many UAP sightings off the coast of San Diego, about 2004-2021 at Off the coast of San Diego, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Off the coast of San Diego, California

tellings.quote: And just where they are, like a lot are off the coast of San Diego.

plain: The economist Tyler Cowen says that a lot of sightings of unidentified aerial phenomena, the official term for UFOs, happen off the coast of San Diego, California. He tells Jesse Michels this as something he has heard from others. The point is that the reports cluster in one place rather than scattering at random.
